name: Smucker Plant - Havre de Grace MD

fieldNotes.location: Roster address 1601 Pulaski Hwy was imprecise. Web search resolved the actual plant to 340 Old Bay Lane, Havre de Grace MD (Smucker Quality Beverages / Smucker Natural Foods), ~640m SE of the geocoded point. Locked center 39.5305, -76.1085 on the industrial building with rooftop solar.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint pinch-point visible at the property entrance in satellite z20. The perimeter loop driveway connects to an open industrial-park intersection. Chain-link fencing runs along property lines but the truck driveway is uncontrolled. Classified false; flagged uncertain because Street View coverage did not reach the plant itself (panos clustered on Old Bay Ln near the neighboring building).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No small staffed booth structure beside any entrance. A small outbuilding sits at the NE corner near the tank farm but it is not positioned as an entry guard booth.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~9 dock doors counted on the SE/S building face, several with trailers backed in. Band 0-10.
fieldNotes.dropArea: A handful of trailers parked along the SE apron and near the NE corner without tractors; no dedicated marked drop lot. Band 0-10.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial park on the outskirts of Havre de Grace; farmland immediately south. Rural per rubric (small-town industrial defaults to Rural).
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Single perimeter loop drive; gate-to-dock approach holds only 1-2 trucks.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: One main plant building. Other large buildings nearby (incl. a separate distribution warehouse to the east and a building NW with CFI trailer) are separate properties in the same park, not the same parcel.
fieldNotes.yardMetrics: Counts are honest estimates from z19-z20 imagery; trailer/dock counts low-confidence at the margin.
